secret.description: Shared secret; checked against Script Property OWN_SECRET.

positions.description: Every role from the `Role` sheet, ordered by `Pořadí` (ascending), with the names of its active members. Roles with no active members are included with an empty `members` array.

label.description: The role label shown on the web (`Označení na webu`).

members.description: Active members holding this role, in sheet row order. The app sorts them by name with Czech ICU collation.

order.description: Sort key (`Pořadí`); positions are ordered by it, ascending.

error.description: Failure reason. The browser ignores it (any failure shows the fallback); the server-side loader forwards it to Sentry.

description: Contract for the Vedneměsíčník editorial-board (redakce) contacts web app. POST an EditorialBoardContactsRequest to read the public subset of the editorial board; the response is an EditorialBoardContactsResponse. Only active members and only their name and role label are exposed — the e-mail, phone and note columns are never read into the response.
title: EditorialBoardContacts
